_comment: Cards that exist only for the blitz cost reduction test (tests/unit/costs/test_blitz_cost_reduction.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_blitz_discounter` is Henzie "Toolbox" Torre's second line on a free body, so the discount can be put on the board without paying for it; the granted blitz it discounts comes from `t_blitz_granter` (tests/data/grant_blitz.cards.json).

cards.name: Test Blitz Discounter
